ROOMZ Display - Easy installation, No cabling

Our meeting and conference room booking displays are installed within minutes and connect using your existing Wi-Fi network. A significant advantage that enables you to deploy the solution in just a few minutes, giving you great flexibility when upgrading your equipment.

Learn more

myROOMZ - Desk Booking Software

The myROOMZ application is designed to solve the problems of today’s flexible offices and helps to manage your hybrid workspaces. Plan your days at the office by reserving your workspaces in advance, coordinate your schedule with your colleagues and view the available meeting room, desk and huddle spaces in real time.

Learn more

ROOMZ Advanced Analytics - Workplace Analytics

With ROOMZ Advanced Analytics, track the actual usage of your desks, meeting rooms and collaborative spaces to redesign your workspaces and maximize productivity.

Learn more

Swiss quality & reliability

ROOMZ components are developed and manufactured in Switzerland. Quality and reliability combined with elegant design.

Low ecological footprint

Our room booking screens are the most power efficient solution in the market. All ROOMZ hardware components are optimized for extremely low power consumption and highest autonomy.

Learn more

Designed specifically for its purpose

  • No cabling

    Easy installation of ROOMZ devices without the need to cable anything. Multiple mounting options are provided.

  • Wi-Fi connected

    ROOMZ will connect to your existing WiFi network, no need to install anything else. OPEN, WEP, WPA2 and WPA2 Enterprise are supported.

  • Low Power

    Typical usage: 4 years for the displays and 4 to 5 years for the sensors. Runs on single Batteries that can easily be replaced.

  • Secure

    Secure communication protocols and encryption.

  • Cloud or On Premise

    ROOMZ can be serviced directly from the cloud or run completely within your own IT infrastructure.

  • Go Green

    ROOMZ devices are extremely energy efficient and have a low ecological footprint. A step towards more sustainable offices.
